content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Bremerton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of experience. Document your hours and verify your background meets PMI's standards before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions at times that fit your schedule, gain hands-on knowledge from active certified practitioners, and receive your training completion certificate required for PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI, report your education and experience, and pay the examination fee. PMI will audit and approve your application, typically within days. Have your training completion certificate and eligibility documentation ready.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources and practice materials to reinforce course content. Schedule your exam at a Pearson testing center and complete the proctored PMP certification exam on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout each three-year renewal cycle by completing training, volunteering, or contributing to the profession. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to stay current in your role.
